}}'''Miyasi''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]], who is also secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Miyasi}}

==Appearance==
She has iron-gray hair and is tall and plump. A stern woman who brooked no nonsense and saw nonsense everywhere.

Having gray hair may indicate that Miyasi is very old, most likely more than two hundred.

Miyasi is very particular and will only eat walnuts if they are whole.

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.
She is one of the sisters to hold the shield over [[Leane Sharif]], when [[Egwene al'Vere]] comes to visit her.

Miyasi is in Ferane's quarters being served by Egwene when Ferane asks her on how she would have approached the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Egwene in turn tries to encourage Ferane and Miyasi to think logically and approach the other Ajahs to try and mend the White Tower cracks that have formed.

In [[Verin Mathwin]]'s book given to Egwene, Miyasi is listed as a member of the [[Black Ajah]]. it is not known if she was able to flee the Tower before Egwene was raised.
